Covariance models and their parameter settings

magCompCovModels.Rd

Lists the covariance families, parameter names, and domains supported by GP and NNGP terms. The same covariance calculations are used for fitting and prediction. uniform() specifies a prior; fixed() marks a starting value as fixed throughout fitting.

Usage

magCompCovModels()
uniform(lower, upper)
fixed(value)

Arguments

lower, upper

Finite bounds for a uniform covariance-parameter prior, with lower < upper. Bounds must respect the parameter's domain.

value

A fixed parameter value, or a named vector of values for factors.

Details

Specify a family with cov_model inside gp(), nngp(), factor_gp(), or factor_nngp(). The default is "exp". For space-time families, the final coordinate is numeric time, for example nngp(easting, northing, year, cov_model = "sep_exp", m = 15). Time gaps are used as supplied. Let \(h\) be spatial distance, \(u\) absolute time separation, and \(d\) the number of spatial coordinates. Correlations are:

exp

\(\exp(-\phi h)\), with phi > 0.

matern

\((\phi h)^\nu K_\nu(\phi h)/(2^{\nu-1}\Gamma(\nu))\), with phi > 0 and nu > 0. At nu = 0.5 this is exponential.

sep_exp

\(\exp(-\phi h-\lambda u)\), with positive phi and lambda.

multi_res_sep_exp

\(\alpha\exp(-\phi_1h-\lambda_1u) +(1-\alpha)\exp(-\phi_2h-\lambda_2u)\). The mixing weight alpha is between zero and one; all four decays are positive.

gneiting

Write \(T=1+a u^{2\alpha}\). Correlation is \(T^{-\delta-d/2}\exp(-c h^{2\gamma}/T^{\beta\gamma})\). Parameters a and c are positive; alpha and gamma are in \((0,1]\); beta is in \([0,1]\); delta is nonnegative.

Magnitude process variance is separate from these correlations and has an inverse-gamma Gibbs update. Composition factors have unit marginal variance.

All estimated covariance parameters have independent bounded uniform priors. Put overrides in a term's covariance list under priors, starting, or tuning. The same parameter names are used in samples() and summary(). For composition, a common scalar setting applies to all factors; a named vector of starts/tuning values or a named list of priors can override individual factors. A named list of starting values can mix fixed(value) and ordinary numeric values across factors. Omitted entries retain defaults. magCompSettings() shows the resolved supports and starts. Fixed parameters do not have priors or proposals.

By default, Matérn smoothness has prior uniform(0.05, 2). Gneiting alpha = fixed(1), gamma = fixed(0.5), and delta = fixed(0); a, c, and beta are estimated. An ordinary starting value or a prior override releases a default-fixed parameter.

Other default supports are calibrated to spatial distances and the time span. For the mixture, the default supports of phi_1 and phi_2 meet at \(30/D\), where \(D\) is maximum spatial separation; component 1 describes longer spatial dependence. Temporal supports are calibrated to dependence up to twice the observed time span. User overrides are direct parameter bounds, not range parameters. Overlapping mixture supports can permit label switching. When a coordinate domain has no positive span, supply the corresponding support or fix its parameter. The technical guide gives the default formulas.

Covariance parameters are proposed jointly within each magnitude process and each composition factor, after bounded-logit transformation, with Jacobian correction. The tuning entries are initial transformed-scale standard deviations (default 0.1). magCompControl(metropolis = ) controls adaptation.

Value

magCompCovModels() returns a named list of registry entries. uniform() returns a prior specification and fixed() a marked numeric value for a covariance starting-value list.

See also

magCompTerms, magCompPriors, magCompStarting, magCompSettings, magCompControl

Examples

magCompCovModels()$sep_exp
~ nngp(easting, northing, year, cov_model = "sep_exp", name = "space_time")
magCompPriors(magnitude = list(terms = list(space_time = list(
  covariance = list(phi = uniform(0.1, 4), lambda = uniform(0.02, 2))))))
# A matching starting-value list for magComp(starting = ...).
list(magnitude = list(terms = list(space_time = list(
  covariance = list(phi = 1, lambda = fixed(0.3))))))
